## Cross-cutting rules

### Taxonomy

- Seven affinity trees (Fire, Chill, Shock, Bleed, Guard, Void, Growth) plus **Neutral**, the palette's constant (not a tree), plus one **secret** card outside the taxonomy (Panda).
- Each tree has exactly one **signature** (its thesis card: the mandatory first pick, which grants the tree's `…Unlocked` capability) and exactly one designated **capstone** (a 5-tier ladder). Ordinary cards may have up to 4 tiers (canon amended Sep 15: T4 allowed, one capstone per tree).
- Tier percentages are totals; an attack-speed % is a firing-rate increase. Synergies (×3/×5/×7) count DISTINCT cards per tree on first pick only; levelling a card never feeds a synergy. A bridge (dual-tag) card counts toward both trees.

### Drafting and eligibility

- **One offer rule for every draw** (CL-89): the level-up spread, reroll, the Boss Mode random opener and the +1 Card bonus all use `UpgradeManager.isOfferable`. A card is offered only if it isn't maxed; its `requires` are held; its next tier's `tierRequires` are held; nothing the run holds is in its `blockedBy`; it isn't secret; its colour (and a bridge's second colour) is in the run's palette; and it isn't a capstone while another capstone is in progress.
- **Signature opening:** while the run holds no signature, spreads offer only signatures (one per active tree); a reroll prefers unseen signatures. **Gateway pity:** an unowned active signature unseen for 3 level-ups takes the front slot (one claimant per draw, longest-waited).
- **Capstone focus and finish:** an in-progress capstone locks every other capstone out and is guaranteed a slot every other level; the +1 Card never offers it.
- **Palette:** 5 colours + Neutral per run, one banned colour honoured, at least one colour always left out; Growth unlocks at Arena 5.
- **Enabler edges (A7a):** Gouge → `critSource` → Hemorrhage (CL-91); Polar Vortex → `polarVortex` → Frost Touch T3 (CL-92); Polar Vortex T4 and the five pellet cards (Warp Shot, Gravity Well, Mirror Edge, Fracture Shot, Riftline) are mutually exclusive, both ways (CL-93, symmetric): T4 grants `glacialCondensation`, which blocks the pellet cards, and each pellet card grants `pelletEffect`, which closes T4; Glacial Drift → Glacial Spikes; Whiteout → Ice Rink (Glacial Drift T5); Gravity Well / Null Bloom → `voidWell` → Dead Circuit; Red Smile needs both the Bleed and Void signatures.
- **Proof:** `tools/catalog-harness` walks the real draw — every draftable card offered and maxed from a fresh run on a full save and a new save — and checks the offer rule across both draws with an independent oracle.
- **Acquisition-time eligibility (A7a corrective F1/F2):** a pick is re-checked when it is TAKEN (`UpgradeManager.acquire` / `isSelectable`), and after the Extra Pick's first card the rest of the table is revalidated — stale cards drop out, nothing replaces them. A card taken during a level-up is never offered again at another tier in that level-up (spread, reroll, +1 Card or a scheduled seat). A capstone whose next tier is closed is stalled: no guarantee, no lockout.

### Damage, hits and kills

- **Player damage pipeline** (CL-5, closure table §D): percentage reductions multiply under a 90% combined ceiling (the kaiju included); flat DEF applies after; lethal rescues go Brace first, then Unbroken Core, never both on one event.
- **Gun damage is a whole number**, usually 1: a shot deals `max(1, Int(damageMultiplier))`. A6's new fractions use unbiased probabilistic rounding (CL-70). CL-94 (ruled, **A7b**) extends that rounding to the direct-hit amplifier chain.
- **Hit classes:** a *primary shot* (the gun's pellet, or the Polar Vortex icicle that replaces it) triggers on-hit riders and advances volley counters; a *primary hit* (anything that 'hits' as a primary, including Red Smile's sweeps) stacks Anomaly, rolls Void Horror and rolls Bloodthirsty but never advances shot counters (CL-39/72/85); a *secondary* (echoes, fragments, shards, returned shots, Shadow Edge) carries named effects only (CL-4/75); a *DoT tick* (Burn, Bleed) takes the 50% boss-class scale and ignores the Boss Mode DEF dial (CL-17/18).
- **Kill credit** goes through one chokepoint (`KillSource`); boss kills go through `onLethalHit`. Some sources (`.burst`, `.sweep`) are reward-only and feed no on-kill effects (Unstable Core, Everglow, Static Crown, Chain Reaction, False Opening) — a closeout-audit item.

### Boss-class treatment

- 'Elite' means **mini-boss** in code. `GameConfig.BossClass` carries 50% levers for capstone damage (`damageScale`), capstone debuffs (`debuffScale`) and DoTs (`dotScale`) on mini-bosses and arena bosses.
- Target-class values that are already boss-specific apply **once**, never through a second lever: Anomaly (mini-boss 20% max HP, boss 3%), Overload stuns (0.25s / 0.5s), Glacial Spikes, Singularity (1%/s).
- Arena bosses are stun-immune in v2.1 and are never trapped, feared or turned into snowmen. Wave spawns pause while a boss lives, and the Boss Mode gauntlet has no adds, so enemy-only effects go quiet there (CL-95 → A7b).

### Geometry (Arena 6 reconciliation, §3 and Rulings 5–6)

- Ordinary direct projectiles (player and enemy) are **blocked** by the Carrier; auto-aim excludes targets without line of sight. Red Smile's sweep needs an exact clear segment per target.
- **Pass:** player-centred auras, global/positionless effects, falling and sky-strike effects, Void beams, and supernatural tethers (the Skybeam lasso, Iron Maiden T5).
- **Never inside solids:** wells, flowers, rooted objects and ground zones can't originate inside; knockback, pulls and teleports resolve out of the footprint; Panda may cross geometry as spectacle but never leaves persistent state inside it.
- Gaps found while writing this packet are ruled for A7b (CL-109): Carrier geometry is respected unless a mechanic has an explicit terrain exemption. Known cases: chain and arc hops, coil shocks and point bursts with no Carrier test; Skybeam T3 homing without the LOS check; Wildbloom flowers and the Tree lion ending inside the Carrier; Vine Wall's one-frame intrusion; Rich Soil skipping the garden radius cap.

### Colour and feel language

- **Purple = danger** (ranged enemies, enemy projectiles). Player-owned Void effects in the world are **indigo** (CL-86). Magnet orbs are blue; health orbs are never magnetized.
- Every new mechanic ships with a readable procedural tell; art polish follows in A9 (with Lyra).

#### Kindle · `fire_1` · ★ signature

- **Copy:** "Projectiles ignite enemies: +0.5 burn DPS, 2s"
- **MORE detail:** "Projectiles ignite enemies (+0.5 burn DPS, 2s). Bosses and mini-bosses take 50% less Burn damage."
- **Tiers:** 1 · **Gates:** grants `fireUnlocked`
- **Family:** on-hit rider, DoT status
- **Geometry:** Rides projectile hits, so delivery is blocked by the Carrier's swept segment test; the status itself has no geometry.
- **Targeting:** Any player projectile that lands (primary pellets, PV icicle, and also echoes, splits and shards — no allowModifiers gate); never Glass Blood fragments, returned shots, Shadow Edge or Red Smile sweeps.
- **Hit class:** On-hit Burn rider (+0.5 DPS per stack, 2s, × Fire bucket at ignition) applied as a `.kindleHit`, so it can add a Crucible stack; ticks pay out as Burn-channel DoT hits.
- **Boss-class:** Arena bosses and mini-bosses ignite and take Burn at BossClass.dotScale 50%, fraction-first before rounding; ticks ignore the Boss Mode DEF dial (CL-18).
- **Kill source:** statusTick (a boss kill credits via the onLethalHit chokepoint with a burn-channel context).
- **Tell:** Enemy rim glows orange 0xFF6633 while burning; bosses show ember pips in the status row beside the HP bar — A1/A4a placeholders, A9 replaces.
- **Rulings:** Q-F1, Q-F2, CL-16, CL-17, CL-18, CL-39
- **Sensitivities:** Shards/echoes/splits also count as Kindle hits (unlike Frost Touch's T3 shard gate); sweeps never ignite (CL-39 'Projectiles…'); the post-Burn rim reset hard-codes red on themed enemies (A4a log).

- **Face:** "Become the fire at the center of the arena."
- **Copy:** T1 "Inner Heat: pulse every 2s for 50% ATK nearby" · T2 "Burning Reach: pulse radius doubled" · T3 "Ragekindled: getting hit grows the pulse" · T4 "Living Furnace: pulse ×2; getting hit grows ATK" · T5 "Everglow: erupt for 500% ATK every 20s"
- **MORE detail:** "Every 2s, a pulse deals 50% ATK to nearby enemies. T2 doubles its radius. T3: each hit you take adds +1% pulse damage, up to +100%. T4 doubles pulse damage, and each hit you take adds +0.5% ATK, up to +50%. T5: every 20s, after a short warning, erupt for 500% ATK across the whole arena. Mini-bosses take half pulse damage. Bosses and mini-bosses take half eruption damage."
- **Tiers:** 5 · **Gates:** needs `fireUnlocked`

## Chill

**Thesis:** Control that escalates into transformation. *(Brandon (spec, Sep 15))* · **8 cards.**

**Synergy ladder** (distinct cards in the tree):

| × | Name | In-game copy | Family | How it works | Boss-class |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | Frostbite | Chilled enemies move even slower | passive stat | Stat only: slowPotencyMultiplier ×2 (effectiveSlow capped at 80%) for Frost Touch, the Glacial Drift trail and Windchill slows; global slows are unaffected. | Applies to mini-bosses in full; arena bosses take none of these slows. |
| 5 | Shatter | Frozen enemies burst when struck | on-hit rider | 20% chance to execute outright (no fragments), ending the hit before its damage, Bleed, Whiteout and Chain Lightning. | Mini-bosses are executed outright; arena bosses are immune (the boss hit paths lack it). |
| 7 | Absolute Zero | The arena slows; shatters come easy | global / positionless | +25% global enemy slow (combined slow capped at 80%) and the Shatter threshold drops 40% → 30%. | Arena bosses are unaffected. |

- **×3 Frostbite** — targeting: n/a · geometry: n/a · kill source: n/a · tell: None beyond the usual slow tint. · sensitivities: Shares the name 'Frostbite' with Polar Vortex T5's vulnerability — a Lyra naming call (§B6 noticed list).
- **×5 Shatter** — targeting: Any enemy struck by a player projectile or Red Smile sweep while isSlowed with personal + global slow ≥ 40% (30% with Chill ×7), counting the same hit's Frost Touch. · geometry: Rides projectile and sweep hits, so the carrier is blocked by the Carrier. · kill source: The striking hit's own source: primary, fragment, capstone (icicle) or melee. · tell: None dedicated — the enemy simply dies. · rulings: CL-3, CL-39, CL-99 · sensitivities: A7b: CL-99 ruled mini-bosses take the 20% max-HP elite chunk instead of dying, and its copy waits for that; a pure global slow never qualifies (needs isSlowed).
- **×7 Absolute Zero** — targeting: Every enemy's movement, mini-bosses included; arena bosses don't read the global slow. · geometry: Positionless; no geometry interaction. · kill source: n/a · tell: None. · rulings: Q-C5, CL-108 · sensitivities: Lights Permafrost for every enemy (Q-C5); the global slow alone never marks an enemy isSlowed for Shatter or Iceburst. A7b: CL-108 ruled — arena bosses stay immune to the Ice Rink / Absolute Zero slow; runtime and copy to be reconciled.

A7b: CL-107 ruled — independent vulnerability channels (Frostbite, Marked, Called); the strongest active multiplier wins, no stacking, each source clears only itself (today they share one slot and Called ending resets it). A7b reconcile (Brandon, Sep 25): T4 marks the arena boss immediately (no 10s wait).

## Guard

**Thesis:** Hold your ground and the ground hits back: two survival layers, mitigation, and retaliation. *(working summary (Claude, from Q-G1 and the A5 commit) — for Lyra to confirm)* · **10 cards.**

**Synergy ladder** (distinct cards in the tree):

| × | Name | In-game copy | Family | How it works | Boss-class |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | Ironhide | Nearby enemies cut damage taken, up to 90% | aura (player-centred), damage layer / shield | Percentage DR of 9% per contributor, 10 max (90%), in the pipeline's ironhide slot inside the shared 90% ceiling. | An arena boss or a mini-boss counts as one contributor. |
| 5 | Thornwall | Reflect 150% of contact damage; bosses take half | on-hit rider | Retaliation of 1.50x the contact's raw pre-mitigation damage (before the Boss Mode ATK dial); never from invulnerable-ignored, Silver-Skin- or Phase-Skin-absorbed contacts. | Arena bosses take it once through BossClass.damageScale (50%) before truncation, with the DEF dial; mini-bosses and normals take the full 1.50x. |
| 7 | Unbroken Core | Survive a lethal hit: 10s invulnerable, +ATK equal to DEF. A shield blocks projectiles. | damage layer / shield | Lethal rescue #2 opening 10s of full invulnerability on its own timer (self-damage included) plus a bonus multiplier of DEF / ATK snapped at the rescue; a persistent shield blocks one hostile projectile and rearms in 6s; collision radius x0.85. | Source-agnostic; boss projectile volleys are blockable, boss area strikes are not. |

- **×3 Ironhide** — targeting: Counts hittable, non-snowman enemies whose surface is within 150pt x DeviceScale, plus the arena boss as one, once per frame after DoTs. · geometry: Aura: no occlusion test, so a hostile behind the Carrier still counts. · kill source: n/a · tell: A faint steel ring around Spark whose opacity tracks the current %, hidden under the kaiju; placeholder until A9. · rulings: CL-52, CL-5 · sensitivities: Ironhide + Aegis at the 90% ceiling (A5 watch 2); Unstable Core self-damage bypasses it.
- **×5 Thornwall** — targeting: Whatever just landed a valid damaging contact on Spark. · geometry: n/a (contact). · kill source: retaliation · tell: No dedicated visual; damage only. · rulings: CL-53, CL-101 · sensitivities: The Slag Titan reflects about 30 per touch at 5:00 (A5 watch 5); Harden/Aegis bounces create fresh contacts that re-trigger it; CL-101 copy: add that bosses take half.
- **×7 Unbroken Core** — targeting: Self: the next lethal hit once Brace is spent; the shield blocks any EnemyProjectileNode (never area strikes). · geometry: n/a · kill source: n/a · tell: Steel (0xB8B2A6) shield on Spark's RIGHT with a gold (0xFFD98A) rim when ready and dim while rearming; the window adds a gold rim, an 'UNBROKEN' HUD countdown and a '+N ATK' pop; placeholder until A9. · rulings: Q-G1, CL-54, CL-55, CL-56, CL-57, CL-68, A5-Q1 · sensitivities: Capstone-level power that must stay readable (A5 watch 6); Fortify at rescue time feeds the snapshot; the unbrokenCoreOwned field is dormant (A7b deletion list).

- **Hit class:** Retaliation on damaging contacts (thorns flat 5 / 17, Retaliate 150% of the raw contact on a 1s global cooldown), T4 a 200% DEF radius burst at 4 kinetic stacks (built by contact and enemy-projectile hits), T5 a direct strike of stored kinetic + thorns; T1/T2 also convert base DEF into the damage multiplier.
- **Boss-class:** Capstone lever applied once: thorns, Retaliate, T4 and T5 take BossClass.damageScale (50%) against mini-bosses and arena bosses; the T4 burst never reaches the arena boss.
- **Kill source:** retaliation (thorns, Retaliate), burst (T4, reward-only), capstone (T5).
- **Tell:** Kinetic stack gauge; cyan-blue (0x1FB6FF) T4 ring and a T5 orb tracer with a white rim; no bespoke A5 art.
- **Rulings:** CL-67, CL-50, CL-69, CL-101, Geo-R5
- **Sensitivities:** Iron Skin's DEF->damage reads base DEF only (not Fortify or Deeproot) and is flagged for balance; CL-101 copy: the +5% / +15% DEF are one-time grants (min +1) and '+250%' thorns is really +240%.

- **Boss-class:** Mini-bosses are slowed at full; arena bosses are unaffected (not in the enemy list).
- **Kill source:** n/a (ground via Thornsoil or Wildwood)
- **Tell:** Deep-green (0x174A2A) fill with a leaf-green (0x5FCF62) rim, Spark's nourished glow and a 'PLANT YOUR GROUND' placement beat, kept distinct from health-green.
- **Rulings:** PhaseC-D2, PhaseC-D2b, Geo-R2
- **Sensitivities:** The ground slow counts as 'slowed' for Chill's slow-conditioned amplifiers (Permafrost, Brittle Cold, Shatter) and Chill x3 doubles it to 60%; Terra + Guard is a positive emergent build (A5 watch 1, don't pre-nerf).

## Secret

#### Pandas. · `v20_panda` · secret

- **Copy:** masked by design (`???` at every tier). Tier names: Pandas. → Panda! → Panda...? → Panda. → PANDA..
- **Tiers:** 5 · **Gates:** none (ungated)
- **Family:** summon, knockback / pull, teleport / pin, falling / sky-strike, transformation, draft rule
- **Geometry:** Panda systems = spectacle pass (Geo Ruling 6): arrival destinations resolve out of solids, a pinned victim is resolved outside the footprint every frame, rolls and bamboo rain ignore travel occlusion, and the kaiju strike target is line-of-sight checked from Spark.
- **Targeting:** Mostly indifferent by design (random or nearest enemy); the samurai picks the healthiest mini-boss, then the boss, then the healthiest normal; the kaiju strike uses the shared priority target.
- **Hit class:** Tiered panda acts (rolls, body checks, pins, aggro pulls, projectile-eating sits, healing naps, bamboo drops, a 5% samurai strike from T4) and at T5 a 10s kaiju every 45s (gun off, aura plus arc strikes, 85% DR inside the 90% ceiling, 0.7x move).
- **Boss-class:** Damage is BossClass-scaled on boss-class; the samurai deletes only below the execute threshold (else 14x ATK at 50%); the kaiju staggers bosses (2.6x ATK at 50%) and never deletes them.
- **Kill source:** summon (panda acts, samurai), capstone (kaiju strike), burst (kaiju aura, reward-only).
- **Tell:** Deliberately masked: '???' copy at every tier, punctuation-only tier names and a '???' HUD timer; 76pt pandas, a 3x kaiju with an orange ember aura, and a white samurai cut that belongs to no tree.
- **Rulings:** Geo-R6, CL-5, CL-44, CL-90, CL-106
- **Sensitivities:** Secret card: never in the random pool or the bonus draw, 9.27% run eligibility (Review Mode forces it), first offer at levels 2-5 then every other level from the pick; neutral tag so it never feeds a synergy; T5 unlocks the earned panda skin at pick; kaiju tuning waits for the art pass.
